results.title: Visualizing data to explore the affective and human ...
results.content: Our research project sought to address this lack of concern or understanding and our primary research question was ‘How do those who work in the field of teacher education articulate and represent the nature of their work?’ We adopted the emerging practices of combining arts-based and data science research methods to invite teacher educators to share their experiences and voices about this work they do. Utilizing arts-based methods to generate data is not new, although when combined with data science methods that include various computational tools to consider datasets, as we did, it is innovative and indicative of the dynamic ways in which ‘researchers and professionals collect, access, and analyse data in service of education’ (Lee *et al.* Citation2021, p. For us, the affordances of fusing arts-based and data science methods lay in the ability to tap into the emotional, lived experience of those working in the field of teacher education and being able to work with images and visualize data for a variety of purposes: for analysis, for interpretation, and for communication (Knaflic Citation2015).

results.title: Extending Digital Narrative with AI, Games, Chatbots, and XR
results.content: In this essay, the core members of the team contribute descriptions of their practice-based research projects, spanning AI chatbots, AI text-to-image generation, AI cinema, AI character development in games, and virtual reality, with an emphasis on the ways that making creative work in these new environments is not only an end in itself, but of a mode of engagement essential to the development of critical insights into how AI and Extended Reality platforms can and will shape and be shaped by human narrative capacities now and in the future. Rather than being a collaboration with an AI chatbot, Republicans in Love only makes use of human writing which is then fed to either a text-to-image generation engine (in the first iteration of the project OpenAI’s DALL•E 2, and in the second DALL•E 3) or a text-to-video generation engine (Runway). Scott Rettberg’s Republicans in Love showcases the analytical potential of creative works in understanding text-to-image generative AI and its capacity for new multimodal narrative genres, such as visual/literary satire.
